config.stacksizetweaks.title: Stack Size Tweaks
config.stacksizetweaks.label.info:
Change the default stack size of items.

Use 0 for max stack size (1,000,000,000).

Changes to stack sizes require a restart to take effect.
config.stacksizetweaks.group.item_groups: Max stack sizes for different item groups
Maximum stack size for regular items.
Maximum stack size for food items.
config.stacksizetweaks.low_stack_limit.d: Maximum stack size for items that normally stack up to 16.
Maximum stack size for stews and soups (foods that use a bowl).
config.stacksizetweaks.potion_stack_limi: Maximum stack size for regular, splash, and lingering potions.
config.stacksizetweaks.bucket_stack_limi: Maximum stack size for bucket items.
config.stacksizetweaks.playable_stack_li: Disc and Goat Horn Stack Limits
Maximum stack sizes for music discs and goat horns.
config.stacksizetweaks.vehicle_stack_lim: Maximum stack sizes for all boat and minecart items.
config.stacksizetweaks.banner_pattern_st: Maximum stack size for banner patterns.
config.stacksizetweaks.enchanted_book_st: Maximum stack size for enchanted books.
config.stacksizetweaks.non_stackable_sta: Maximum stack size for all items that don't stack normally and don't have durability. Will likely cause issues for some items.
config.stacksizetweaks.overrides.descrip:
Change stack sizes for specific items.
Format: minecraft:example_item=64
Max stack limits for containers (e.g. hoppers, dispensers, droppers for farms and sorters). 0 means default to item max stack size.
config.stacksizetweaks.redstone_containe: Global stack limit for all redstone containers (dispensers, droppers, hoppers, crafters). 0 means default to item max stack size.
config.stacksizetweaks.dispenser_stack_l: Maximum stack size per slot in dispensers. 0 inherits from Redstone Containers Limit.
config.stacksizetweaks.dropper_stack_lim: Maximum stack size per slot in droppers. 0 inherits from Redstone Containers Limit.
config.stacksizetweaks.hopper_stack_limi: Maximum stack size per slot in hoppers. 0 inherits from Redstone Containers Limit.
config.stacksizetweaks.crafter_stack_lim: Maximum stack size per slot in crafters. 0 inherits from Redstone Containers Limit.
config.stacksizetweaks.vanilla_comparato: Use the vanilla stack size of items for comparator comparing.
config.stacksizetweaks.amount_tooltip.de: Display a tooltip that shows the precise amount of items for large stack sizes.
config.stacksizetweaks.font_option.descr: Font used to render item amounts inside the inventory.
config.stacksizetweaks.shorten_item_amou: Make item counts show up as short as possible i.e. 300M -> 0.3B, 123K -> 0.1M.
